key_findings: A Level-1 predictive weight of zero preserves patient-cost metrics but collapses bidirectional CPT/ICD claim retrieval.
A weight of 0.1 recovers all claim alignment measured at weight 1.0 with indistinguishable patient-cost and missing-modality metrics.

Learned query pooling, token self-attention, TTNC variants, a cross-attention Level-2 decoder, masked-claim JEPA, and multi-hypothesis prediction did not clear the joint cost/geometry/robustness gate.
History 100 improved three-seed mean RMSE by 13.249 dollars but reduced silhouette by 0.0231 and worsened mean missing-CPT RMSE by 519.354 dollars with high variance.
evaluation_policy: Frozen validation split only; the test split was not used for selection.
